# GNU Wget 1.24.5 provenance

TrimPod(RUS) bundles an AArch64 GNU Wget executable for HTTPS requests to
LRCLIB. GNU Wget is GPL-3.0-or-later.

- Upstream release source: `wget-1.24.5.tar.gz`
- Upstream URL: <https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/wget/wget-1.24.5.tar.gz>
- Source archive SHA-256:
  `FA2DC35BAB5184ECBC46A9EF83DEF2AAAA3F4C9F3C97D4BD19DCB07D4DA637DE`
- Bundled executable SHA-256:
  `8BE6464DD41F601612F4CA73397E8EC756B2AB6056D4571B5D5F0A860751F6D2`

The executable was inherited unchanged from the NextUI Music Player release
artifact identified in `pak/licenses/wget_NOTICE.txt`; that project is the
binary provenance, not the author or upstream source of GNU Wget. The official
GNU source archive is checked in here so recipients do not depend on a local
path or a third-party binary repository to obtain the corresponding version's
source.
